errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the chart as having grouped bars. It is a simple bar chart, with one bar per category. A grouped bar chart would feature multiple bars for each category.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind visuell absteigend angeordnet, beginnend mit dem höchsten Preis in Nordrhein-Westfalen und endend mit dem niedrigsten Preis in Saarland.
errors.evidence: This sentence is redundant as it repeats the information about the descending order of the bars and the highest/lowest values, which were already mentioned in the first and third sentences.
